summary.zh: 对比直销与伙伴渠道的成本、回报与配比
summary.en: Compare direct and partner channel cost, ROI and mix

description.zh: 评估直销与合作伙伴渠道的完全服务成本与投入回报，并在约束条件下给出较优的渠道配比。适合年度渠道复盘，或决定是否新增伙伴渠道时使用。
description.en: Reviews the fully loaded cost to serve and ROI of direct versus partner channels, then recommends a mix under real constraints. Use it for an annual channel review or before adding a partner route.
